title: Portal Tools for the Field
short_answer: Field Manual teaches the work. Job Check writes stage status to Monday. Job Start is the Sales→Ops handoff. Morning Brief is private prep — never a channel broadcast.
summary: What each tile is for, who uses it, and what paper or Monday form it replaced. If it is not online, we are doing it the old way on purpose — or we forgot.
plain_words: The portal is how GVC keeps one truth across phones. Field Manual teaches the work. Job Check writes stage status to Monday. Job Start is the Sales→Ops handoff packet. Morning Brief is private prep on your phone — never a channel broadcast. Office tools need grants you may not have.
when_to_use: First day on a GVC job — know which tile does what
Before updating Job Check trade stages
When someone asks where the Morning Brief or handoff packet lives
prerequisites: Portal sign-in on your GVC Google account
Job Check grant for trade column updates (admin assigns)

tools.name: Phone or tablet with portal access

steps.title: Open Job Check
steps.body: Find the active job — search by name, address, or Project #.

steps.title: Tap finished stages only
steps.body: Framing, Hanging, Scrapping, Taped, coats, Sanded, Text/Skim, Finishing, Cleaned Out. Cycle chips include "(not set)" so you can clear a mistake.

steps.title: Save once
steps.body: Only changed fields go to Monday. Read confirmed values after save — if something failed, fix that column; do not guess.

steps.title: Office-owned columns
steps.body: Do not touch money, contract, or Project Status. Job Check will not offer them; do not ask someone to flip Project Status from the field.

steps.title: Missing Projects link
steps.body: If the page says the Projects link is missing, save Ops fields anyway and tell the office — trade chips need the link.

steps.title: Field Manual on phone
steps.body: Plain = enough to do the job. Full detail = assemblies and specs for leads. Start a shared checklist for the job — crew can resume each other's runs.

steps.title: Stage names match procedures
steps.body: Job Check stage names match drywall procedure titles on purpose — move between tools without translating.

warnings.title: Morning Brief — never #operations
warnings.body: Field brief, huddle summary, route sheet, and prep status are always a side chat or DM. Do not post them to Slack #operations — not for review, not temporarily, not after someone signs off. Job Check / Job Start notices are a different flow.

experts.summary: Field Manual: procedures, Plain/Full detail, per-job checklists — replaces paper SOPs. Job Check: Framing/Hang/Scrap/coats/Finish/Cleaned Out — replaces PandaDoc Job Check and verbal "we're done." Job Start: handoff packet (lock box, board count, exclusions, open questions) — replaces old e-forms. Morning Brief: today's prep/route/huddle on your phone — replaces scattered texts. Change Order (office grant): documented extras. Lien Watch (office/lead): deadline awareness — counsel still reviewing math.

quality_checks.prompt: Job Check updated only for stages actually finished — explicit Save tap
No attempt to change contract, money, or Project Status columns from the field
Morning Brief / huddle content stays in side chat or DM — never #operations

common_mistakes.title: Advancing stages on hope
common_mistakes.wrong: Flip Job Check chips before QC pass
common_mistakes.right: QC Walk first; then honest stage update
common_mistakes.why: Monday becomes a lie the office plans against

common_mistakes.title: Broadcasting the brief
common_mistakes.wrong: Post route or prep to #operations for visibility
common_mistakes.right: Side chat or DM only — locked policy
common_mistakes.why: Morning Brief is private prep, not ops channel traffic
